title: A colon at the margin after a block scalar key belongs to the mapping around it
notes: In `c:` the inner mapping holds one explicit key, the folded scalar `a` plus a line feed (the pointer segment is `a` and a line feed), with no value. The `: 1` at column 0 is not indented under it: it is the value of an empty key in the outer mapping, whose other entry is `c`. Removing the inner entry leaves `c` with an empty mapping, written `{}` (kit convention, docs/edit-semantics.md: an emptied nested collection leaves `{}`), and the margin entry `: 1` stays as it is.

provenance.reference: An editor that took the margin colon for the value of the removed key and deleted it with the entry.
